content:
The test image shows a leaf with numerous small, round, whitish/pale spots scattered across the dark green leaf surface. The spots appear to be powdery or dusty in texture, distributed across the entire leaf blade. The leaf itself shows some curling/distortion. There is no dark necrotic lesion pattern typical of anthracnose, no sooty black coating, no galls, and no canker-type lesions.

The scattered white powdery spots uniformly distributed across the leaf surface are highly characteristic of **Powdery Mildew**.
